title: Menten AI presents at BioEurope 2025
summary: Innovation Showcase: Menten AI, Inc. Menten AI's CEO, Hans Melo, and VP of Business Development, Andrea McNeal, attended and presented at BioEurope 2025 this November 3–5. The event brings together global leaders in biotechnology and pharma to explore collaborations and innovation in drug discovery. We look forward to sharing Menten AI’s latest advances in AI-driven protein design and connecting with partners shaping the future of biotech.
body_markdown: Menten AI was proud to have our CEO, **Hans Melo** , and VP of Business Development attend and present at **BioEurope 2025** , held November 3–5. The event brought together global leaders in biotechnology and pharma to explore collaboration and innovation in drug discovery. Our team shared Menten AI’s latest advances in AI-driven peptide design and connected with partners shaping the future of biotech.
